effective_entry: Each canonical purpose inherits conformance; no purpose field is optional.

actor-contract.job: Print the versioned CLI actor syntax contract
actor-contract.why: Let operator tools inspect the pinned binary instead of copying command and path rules
actor-contract.inputs: optional effective instance and path output
actor-contract.defaults: static contract without config or daemon access
actor-contract.output: JSON contract and computed SHA-256; optional effective paths
actor-contract.authority: syntax metadata only; no daemon authority grant
actor-contract.recovery: correct local config if effective path resolution fails

setup.job: Configure this machine for its person
setup.why: Persist identity before starting a daemon and keep downloaded binaries at a stable path
setup.inputs: person, node, config path and service/install/start choices
setup.defaults: background service and local installation; terminal prompts unless flags answer them
setup.success: configuration saved and the requested daemon is ready
setup.authority: local person process; unavailable in agent seats
setup.recovery: correct flags or inspect the daemon log and repeat setup

changes.job: Read Git change state and explicitly synchronize retained metadata
changes.why: Expose source, ref, index and evidence freshness while retaining the PR path
changes.model: Git change observation and local derived receipts
changes.inputs: configured repository name, full Change-Id, offline flag and bounded list cursor
changes.defaults: feature disabled; list limit 50; one designated reader per repository
changes.output: bounded list, exact change detail or typed sync admission
changes.success: indexed state with explicit freshness or unavailable PR fallback
changes.authority: read.projections for reads; control.work for sync; operator-owned transport
changes.recovery: use the named reader or the PR path; configure transport before activation

ui.why: Spaces collect conversations, Home, missions and agent terminals
ui.inputs: space, classic, demo, local or client options
ui.defaults: last space; paired device when available, otherwise local daemon
ui.output: interactive terminal; demo dump supports text snapshots
ui.success: terminal restored when the UI exits
ui.recovery: reconnect or pair with st devices complete

apply.why: Seats, missions and schedules share one preview and atomic publication
apply.inputs: version-2 KDL files; optional owned-set source and revision flags
apply.defaults: plain upsert; dry runs execute no commands unless --check
apply.output: resolved preview or publication receipt; gate answers on stderr
apply.success: valid preview or atomic publication under captured subject heads
apply.recovery: correct blockers or refresh stale fences
apply.human_example: st apply seats.kdl missions.kdl schedules.kdl --as person/operator --dry-run

owned-sets.job: Publish and inspect complete owned membership
owned-sets.why: Omission retires managed declarations under source and graph fences
owned-sets.inputs: complete version-2 KDL bundle, repository, ref, SHA, source sequence and expected set revision
owned-sets.output: preview, publication receipt or set status
owned-sets.success: atomic selected membership or exact commit rollout state
owned-sets.authority: explicit publication actor or read scope
owned-sets.recovery: refresh fences and preview retirement before retrying

note.job: Read or replace current person context
note.why: Give owned agents bounded advisory context without granting authority
note.actor: person or agent reads; only a person writes their own note
note.inputs: nonblank text and optional UTC expiry
note.defaults: authenticated local actor; one current note per person
note.output: authorized current notes or replacement revision
note.success: bounded explicit read or person-owned set/clear
note.authority: local person identity for writes; bounded owner/work relationships for agent reads
note.recovery: replace or clear the current note; upgrade and fence peers before publication

usage.job: Review harness token usage across the fleet
usage.why: Show attributed token spend and API-equivalent cost by agent, mission, step, model, account, and host
usage.inputs: period and grouping; --messages-only for count-only coordination metadata
usage.defaults: all groups for the last 24 hours

slo.job: See whether the fleet is meeting its objectives and budgets
slo.why: Show every target with its error budget and every resetting allowance, such as an account's weekly and 5-hour limits, and explain one in plain words
slo.output: target, current value, window and remaining budget for each row
slo.success: every row in the targets file and every reported account limit is listed
slo.recovery: rerun; rows are computed on each read from live windows and limit readings

missions.why: Mission definitions, graph progress, and lifecycle are one workflow
missions.inputs: authored KDL, mission/run ID, and filters
missions.success: the exact KDL is published or membership and action agree
missions.recovery: correct preview blockers or refresh stale generation

launch.job: Author and approve a mission launch
launch.why: Expose the human launch workflow, not internal planning

attention.job: Answer alerts: what blocks or waits on a person
attention.why: Keep every ask, gate and approval in one list, each attached to its agent's conversation
attention.defaults: unresolved items for the named person
attention.authority: explicit named person; never ambient identity

machines.why: Placement needs health and capacity together

agents.job: Find live agents and typed ownership
agents.why: Agent state needs list and detail parity

seed-acknowledgement.job: Record acceptance of an interrupted native seed attempt
seed-acknowledgement.why: Preserve the first-launch fence while acknowledging its incomplete notice
seed-acknowledgement.inputs: seat subject, nonempty reason, optional actor
seed-acknowledgement.defaults: configured person; a harness supplies its own explicit actor
seed-acknowledgement.output: immutable acknowledgement claim citing the original receipt
seed-acknowledgement.success: one durable acknowledgement; exact replay returns the same claim without rearming seed
seed-acknowledgement.authority: attributed fleet actor; a harness acts only as itself
seed-acknowledgement.recovery: inspect the receipt and retry the exact actor and reason; fresh launch never requires acknowledgement
seed-acknowledgement.human_example: st agents acknowledge-seed AGENT --reason REASON --as ACTOR
seed-acknowledgement.json_example: st agents acknowledge-seed AGENT --reason REASON --as ACTOR --json

conversations.why: Messages and sessions form one timeline
conversations.actions: sessions timeline send reply wait read archive

devices.why: Remote identity needs explicit person control

clients.job: See which clients are connected now
clients.why: Tell which stui, phone and st builds reach this member and when each was last seen
clients.defaults: connected now and seen in the last few minutes
clients.output: client name, build, where it connects from, and when it was seen
clients.success: bounded list from this member's memory
clients.recovery: reconnect the client; the list forgets clients after a few minutes

work.why: Humans and workers need one truthful fenced queue contract
work.inputs: optional explicit agent filter; step generation attempt incarnation for actions
work.success: list/detail agree and mutations make one durable fenced transition
work.actions: claim renew progress complete fail release publish-mission
work.authority: read scope or explicit eligible agent lease

lanes.job: Show and change ordered lanes such as a merge train
lanes.why: People and agents join a lane with one command and every replica shows the same order
lanes.inputs: lane subject run or name; entry subject or short entry; placement state detail head reason
lanes.output: lane entries in order with status and recent changes
lanes.success: each change is one lane claim and the view shows the new order
lanes.authority: person or agent actor; approve only by the lane approver
lanes.recovery: show the lane and repeat the change

terminals.why: Terminal control needs screen and frame fencing

repair.why: Converge legacy or interrupted graph state without rewriting history
repair.success: exact plan applied or zero-change retry
repair.recovery: rerun dry-run after a stale token

uninstall.why: Leave nothing behind when a machine stops running st
uninstall.defaults: leave the fleet first and keep nothing
uninstall.output: removed paths and anything that remains
uninstall.success: services state settings and sockets removed
uninstall.recovery: install again and join with a new code

fleet.job: Join machines into a fleet and manage its members
fleet.why: Make adding and removing a machine one command on each side
fleet.authority: local person on a listening member
fleet.recovery: rerun join or remove the stranded member and invite again

backup.job: Save and restore the signed claim log
backup.why: Recover the shared graph across risky upgrades
backup.inputs: archive file and optional private source copy or empty offline destination
backup.defaults: live daemon for create; configured state database for restore
backup.output: archive path or verified graph digests and fresh writer identity
backup.success: complete archive published or exact log recovered at the current schema
backup.authority: local daemon read access and offline database ownership
backup.recovery: keep the source archive, inspect the failure and retry into an empty offline database

service.actions: install status permissions restart reset uninstall

subject.why: Provide one expert explorer without table leakage

gh.job: Watch a GitHub issue or pull request as an agent seat, and post as the seat
gh.why: A seat hears each comment, review, required-check result and close once, without a poller per thread, and its own posts are told apart by GitHub ID though every agent shares one login
gh.actor: agent seat; a person may list watches and end any
gh.inputs: OWNER/REPO#N or a GitHub URL; deadline; comment text or file
gh.defaults: this seat's watches; watch the thread when commenting
gh.output: the watch with its thread, state and deadline, or the posted comment's ID
gh.success: one watch per seat and thread, and one wake per event
gh.authority: the seat's own identity; the GitHub token st observers use
gh.recovery: st gh ls shows a degraded observer's reason; watch again to begin a new watch

claim.job: Append or inspect a low-level claim

diagnostic.why: Give agents one authorized typed fault-report path
diagnostic.defaults: active error in the current incarnation

skill.job: Print or install the st agent skill
skill.why: Give each harness the st usage text that matches this binary
skill.output: the skill text, or each installed path
skill.success: the skill file holds these exact bytes
skill.json_example: none: st skill prints Markdown; st skill install claude codex prints paths

admission.job: Allow or revoke a local exact-build harness admission exception
admission.why: Let a person start a working installation when isolated admission cannot run, without forging measured evidence
admission.actor: local person outside an agent seat
admission.inputs: harness, installed executable, optional state directory, and required override reason
admission.defaults: harness on PATH and configured local state directory
admission.success: the local exception is persisted or removed without spawning a producer
admission.actions: override revoke; restart only the affected seat
admission.authority: local operating-system user owning the seats; no daemon or graph authority
admission.recovery: correct executable/state path or reason; revoke to restore retained measurements

gate.why: Built-in gate kinds run as exec gates whose command is st gate KIND
gate.inputs: kind and target: a pull request, a check and ref, or a cargo test target
gate.defaults: cargo-test tests origin/main in a worktree st keeps
gate.output: one answer line: pass, not yet, or broken, with why
gate.success: exit 0 passes, 1 is not yet, 3 is broken
gate.actions: revise the gate when it is broken
gate.authority: the GitHub token st observers use; local git and cargo
gate.recovery: read the answer line and the command output

rules.why: Lock a fleet down when its person wants, logging before refusing
rules.success: rule set in the requested mode

sekrets.job: Run any CLI with credentials no seat can read
sekrets.why: A seat uses a profile it was granted, under an allow and deny policy, while the credential stays with the sekrets user
sekrets.inputs: command after --, profile, policy presets and rules, grantee, expiry
sekrets.defaults: the person's default profile, or the one granted profile that allows the command
sekrets.output: the command's own output and exit status; profiles, grants and the call log
sekrets.success: the command ran as the profile, or was refused with the rule that refused it
sekrets.actions: run login put lock unlock profile grant revoke log enable setup
sekrets.authority: kernel caller identity: a person's login session, or a seat its daemon vouches for
sekrets.recovery: st sekrets whoami, then st sekrets log

tiles.job: Run an agent's tools in its tile: its own Unix user, namespaces and root-owned cgroup
tiles.why: Another tile cannot read its files, see its processes, reach its sockets or pass for it, and its tools cannot reach the host
tiles.inputs: tile name from root's registry, command after --
tiles.output: the command's own output and exit status
tiles.success: the command ran as the tile and nothing of it is left when it ends
tiles.authority: root; the registry is root-controlled, the launcher allocates each tile's user ID, and a tile is named by its user ID and cgroup
tiles.recovery: st tiles stop, then systemctl status st-tile-NAME-tools.service
tiles.human_example: sudo st tiles run atlas -- python3 -c 'print(1)'
tiles.json_example: sudo st tiles run atlas -- true

evidence.job: Import, inspect and verify portable gate evidence in git notes
evidence.why: Carry signed observations with source and enforce accepted-base evidence policy offline
evidence.inputs: repository, full record ID or pinned revision/base/change ID, external trusted SSH signer list
evidence.defaults: current repository; JSON output; daemon policy permits full trust only
evidence.output: immutable notes ref, statement, signature trust tier or gate verdict
evidence.success: record imported under explicit tier rules or required evidence verified
evidence.authority: operator-supplied SSH trust list and accepted-base policy
evidence.recovery: supply missing trusted evidence or rerun keyed checks; never silently promote a tier

documents.why: Address exact content outside CLI text

blobs.job: Upload and read the images a message carries
blobs.why: Move a pasted screenshot between machines without putting its bytes in sync
blobs.defaults: type from the file's bytes; actor from ST_AGENT
blobs.recovery: upload again; the same bytes answer the same reference

import.job: Bring an existing native harness session under st
import.why: Preserve useful Codex, Claude, Pi, OMP, and OpenCode context while gaining durable ownership
import.inputs: native session revision and exact process evidence
import.output: native session cards or import receipt
import.success: the exact predecessor is stopped and one durable ownerless resumed agent seat starts
import.recovery: stop an ambiguous native process before retrying

debug.why: Keep debug primitives out of product workflows

removed.why: Reject aliases and direct users to one canonical noun

release_blocking_regressions.rule: human and JSON retain every enriched running agent
the ID printed by send is accepted unchanged by --in-reply-to
